meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For **oily skin**, I’d prioritize a gentle cleanser that controls oil without leaving your face tight or “squeaky.” Salicylic acid is particularly useful if you also have blackheads, clogged pores, or pimples. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks under ₹500

### [Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser]()
*₹269*

### [The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid Gel Face Wash]()
*₹239*

### [Dot & Key Cica Calming Blemish Clearing Face Wash]()
*₹214*

### [The Derma Co 2% Niacinamide Oily Skin Cleanser]()
*₹223*

### [Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash]()
*₹81*

**🥇 Best overall: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser — ~₹269**  
Best choice if your skin is **oily + acne/blackhead-prone**. It combines 2% salicylic acid with LHA and is aimed at excess oil and clogged pores. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-salicylic-acid-face-washes-for-acne-prone-skin-in-monsoon-11662605?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 If you're new to salicylic acid: The Derma Co 1% Salicylic Acid — ~₹239**  
A milder option if 2% products tend to make your skin dry or irritated.

**🥉 If your skin is oily but somewhat sensitive: The Derma Co 2% Niacinamide Oily Skin Cleanser — ~₹223**  
I'd choose this over a strong exfoliating cleanser if your main problem is **oiliness rather than acne**.

**Budget/basic option: Himalaya Purifying Neem — ~₹81**  
Fine if you simply want an inexpensive everyday cleanser, but I'd pick the Minimalist or Derma Co options if you have clogged pores or breakouts.

**My pick for you:** **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid**, unless your skin is sensitive. Use it **once daily initially**, moisturize afterward, and use sunscreen during the day. Don't scrub your face aggressively or combine it with lots of other exfoliating products.

If you tell me **(1) whether you get pimples/blackheads and (2) whether your skin is sensitive**, I can narrow it down to **one exact face wash**.
